verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email platform, but the evidence describes only a hosted service used through its API, SDKs, CLI and a remote MCP endpoint at mcp.loops.so. Nothing documents a deployable or self-hostable version of the core product, and the CLI and SDKs are clients of the hosted service, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
